Then the percentage of the population who look into advertisements is:
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
Let nA and nB be the percentage of population in a city who read newspaper A and B respectively.

Therefore, nA=25, nB=20 and nA∩B=8

Now, we know that

nA∩B¯=nA-nA∩B

⇒nA∩B¯=25-8

⇒nA∩B¯=17

And,

nA¯∩B=nB-nA∩B

⇒nA¯∩B=20-8

⇒nA¯∩B=12

Therefore, percentage of those who read advertisements is

=30% of nA∩B¯+40% of nB∩A¯+50% of nA∩B

=30100×17+40100×12+50100×8

=1390100

Total persons who look into advertisement =13.9%
